# Al Najim Al Satie Steel Shelfs Trdg

> Al Najim Al Satie Steel Shelfs Trdg is a Sharjah, UAE manufacturer and integrator of material handling products and systems for manufacturing, assembly, distribution centres, warehousing and storage facilities.

## Products and services

- Pallet racks
- Heavy duty racks
- Supermarket shelving and storage systems
- Slotted angle shelves
- Mezzanine flooring with rack support
- Aluminium fabrication
- Structural fabrication
- Stainless steel fabrication
- Car parking sheds
- Retractable shades
- Fence cabana with wooden bench
- Interior decor

## Industries served

- Manufacturing
- Assembly
- Distribution centres
- Warehousing
- Storage facilities
